body.text:
atha vidyādharakalpaṃ pravakṣye sattvānukampayā /
namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya /
body.translated_text: Now I shall proclaim the <s>Vidyādhara Kalpa</s> (chapter of the spell-bearers) out of compassion for beings. Homage to the <s>Buddha</s>, homage to the <s>Dharma</s>, homage to the <s>Saṃgha</s>.

body.text: namo bhagavate śākyamunaye mahākāruṇikāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namaḥ samantebhyaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhebhyaḥ / oṃ giri giri giriṇi giriṇi girivati guṇavati ākāśavati ākāśaviśuddhe sarvapāpavigate ākāśe gaganatale ākāśavicāriṇi maṇidhari vajriṇi jvalitaśikhare maṇimuktākhacitamaulidhare sukeśe suveṣe suvaktre sunetre suvarṇagaure atīte anutpanne anāgate pratyutpanne namaḥ sarvabuddhānāṃ jvalitaujasāṃ buddhe subuddhe bhagavati surakṣaṇi akṣaya sukṣaya sūkṣme suprabhe sudame sudānte suvrate varade pravare bhagavati bhadravati subhadravati bhadre subhadre vimale jayabhadre caṇḍi pracaṇḍi caṇḍe vajracaṇḍe mahācaṇḍe gauri gandhāri caṇḍāli mātaṅgi vaccasi sumati pukkasi sumukhi śabari śāvari śaṃkari dramaṇḍi drāmaṇḍi raudriṇi sarvārthasādhani paramārthasādhani hana hana sarvaśatrūn daha daha sarvaduṣṭān pretapiśācaḍākinīmanuṣyāmanuṣyāṇāṃ
body.translated_text: Homage to the Blessed <s>Śākyamuni</s>, the greatly compassionate <s>Tathāgata</s> (Thus-gone One), <s>Arhat</s> (Worthy One), perfectly and fully awakened one. Homage to all the perfectly and fully awakened <s>Buddhas</s>. Oṃ giri giri giriṇi giriṇi, O mountain-dweller, O virtuous one, O sky-dweller, O one pure as space, O one free from all sins, O one in the sky, on the surface of the heavens, O one who traverses the sky, O jewel-bearer, O vajra-holder, O blazing-peaked one, O one wearing a crown studded with gems and pearls, O beautiful-haired one, O beautifully adorned one, O beautiful-faced one, O beautiful-eyed one, O golden-fair one, O one beyond the past, unborn, beyond the future, present—homage to all the <s>Buddhas</s> of blazing radiance, O awakened one, O well-awakened one, O Blessed Lady, O excellent protector, O imperishable one, O well-diminishing one, O subtle one, O radiant one, O well-tamed one, O well-subdued one, O one of excellent vows, O boon-granter, O most excellent one, O Blessed Lady, O auspicious one, O most auspicious one, O fortunate one, O most fortunate one, O pure one, O victorious and auspicious one, O fierce one, O very fierce one, O wrathful one, O vajra-wrathful one, O greatly wrathful one, O <s>Gaurī</s>, O <s>Gandhārī</s>, O <s>Caṇḍālī</s>, O <s>Mātaṅgī</s>, O <s>Vaccasī</s>, O <s>Sumatī</s>, O <s>Pukkasī</s>, O <s>Sumukhī</s>, O <s>Śabarī</s>, O <s>Śāvarī</s>, O <s>Śaṃkarī</s>, O <s>Dramaṇḍī</s>, O <s>Drāmaṇḍī</s>, O <s>Raudriṇī</s>, O accomplisher of all purposes, O accomplisher of the highest purpose, destroy, destroy all enemies, burn, burn all the wicked ones—of <s>pretas</s> (hungry ghosts), <s>piśācas</s> (flesh-eating spirits), <s>ḍākinīs</s>, humans and non-humans,

body.text: paca hṛdayaṃ vidhvaṃsaya jīvitaṃ sarvaduṣṭagrahāṇāṃ nāśaya naśaya sarvapāpāni me bhagavati / rakṣa rakṣa mama sarvasattvānāñ ca sarvatra sarvadā sarvabhayopadravebhyaḥ / sarvaduṣṭānāṃ bandhanaṃ kuru kuru / sarvakilviṣanāśani mārtaṇḍe mṛtyudaṇḍe mṛtyudaṇḍanivāriṇi mānande mānini mahāmānini mānadhāriṇi cale vicale vimale viṭi viṭi taṭi tiṭi niṭi niṭi tuṭṭe dhoriṇi dhariṇi nimiṇi viriṇi vīryaṇi pracale pravarasamare caṇḍāli mātaṅgi rundhasi karasi śarasi varcasi sumati pukkasi śabari śabari śaṃkari mani draviḍi ḍāviḍi hanani dahani pacani pācani marddani sarali sarale saralambhe hīnamadhyotkṛṣṭavidāriṇi mahiri mahiri mahāmahili nigaḍe nigaḍabhaṃje marte marte matti mattini dāṃte cakre cakravākini jvale jvale jvalini śabari śābari sarvavyādhihariṇi muni muni cuṇḍi cuṇḍi cuṇḍini cuṇḍini mahācuṇḍini nimi nimi nimiṃdhari trailokyavardhani trilokajanani trilokālokakari traidhātukavyavalokani vajraparaśupāśamuṣalakhaḍgacakratriśūlacintāmaṇimakuṭamahāvidyādhāriṇi rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca sarvasthānagata sarvaduṣṭabhayebhyaḥ sarvamanuṣyāmanuṣyabhayebhyaḥ sarvavyādhibhyaḥ / vajre vajre vajravati vajradhare vajrapāṇidhare hiri hiri mili mili kili kili cili cili śili śili cala cala vala vala varade
body.translated_text: cook their hearts, shatter the lives of all wicked <s>grahas</s> (seizing spirits), destroy, destroy all my sins, O Blessed Lady! Protect, protect me and all beings everywhere and always from all fears and calamities! Bind, bind all the wicked ones! O destroyer of all evil, O <s>Mārtaṇḍa</s> (the Sun), O staff of death, O averter of the staff of death, O delightful one, O proud one, O greatly proud one, O bearer of pride, O moving one, O trembling one, O pure one, viṭi viṭi taṭi tiṭi niṭi niṭi tuṭṭe, O bearer, O supporter, nimiṇi viriṇi, O powerful one, O moving one, O foremost in battle, O <s>Caṇḍālī</s>, O <s>Mātaṅgī</s>, O one who obstructs, O one who acts, O one who strikes, O radiant one, O <s>Sumatī</s>, O <s>Pukkasī</s>, O <s>Śabarī</s>, O <s>Śabarī</s>, O <s>Śaṃkarī</s>, O <s>Maṇī</s>, O <s>Draviḍī</s>, O <s>Ḍāviḍī</s>, O destroyer, O burner, O cooker, O ripener, O crusher, sarali sarale saralambhe, O tearer of the low, middling, and exalted, mahiri mahiri mahāmahili, O fetter, O breaker of fetters, O death-dealer, O death-dealer, O intoxicating one, O intoxicator, O tamed one, O wheel, O <s>cakravākī</s> (ruddy goose), O blazing one, O blazing one, O flaming one, O <s>Śabarī</s>, O <s>Śābarī</s>, O remover of all diseases, O sage, O sage, O <s>Cuṇḍī</s>, O <s>Cuṇḍī</s>, O <s>Cuṇḍinī</s>, O <s>Cuṇḍinī</s>, O great <s>Cuṇḍinī</s>, nimi nimi nimiṃdhari, O increaser of the three worlds, O mother of the three worlds, O illuminator of the three worlds, O observer of the three realms, O bearer of the great <s>vidyā</s> (knowledge-spell) with the vajra, axe, noose, mace, sword, discus, trident, and <s>cintāmaṇi</s> (wish-fulfilling jewel) crown, protect, protect me and all beings in all places from all fears of the wicked, from all fears of humans and non-humans, from all diseases! O vajra, O vajra, O vajra-endowed one, O vajra-holder, O one holding a vajra in hand, hiri hiri mili mili kili kili cili cili śili śili, move, move, vala vala, O boon-granter,

body.text: varadāṃkuśe sarvatra jayalabdhe svāhā / sarvapāpavidāriṇi svāhā / sarvavyādhihariṇi svāhā / garbhasaṃbharaṇi svāhā / sarvatra bhayaharaṇi svāhā / svasti bhavatu mama sarvasattvānāñ ca svāhā / oṃ bhuvaḥ svāhā / svasti svāhā / śānti svāhā / puṣṭi svāhā / balavarddhani svāhā / oṃ jayatu jayavati jayakamale vimale svāhā / vipule svāhā / sarvatathāgatamūrte svāhā / oṃ bhūri mahāśānte svāhā / oṃ bhuḥ bhūri bhūri vajravati sarvatathāgatahṛdayapūraṇi āyuḥsandhāraṇi bale balavati / oṃ jayavijaye hūm hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi hūm hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā // oṃ maṇivajre hṛdayavajre mārasainyavidrāvaṇi hana hana sarvaśatrūn vajragarbhe trāsaya trāsaya sarvamārabhavanāni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ saṃbhara saṃbhara svāhā / buddhamaitrī sarvatathāgatavajrakalpādhiṣṭhite sarvakarmāvaraṇāny apanaye svāhā /
body.translated_text: O boon-hook, O one victorious everywhere, <s>svāhā</s>! O tearer of all sins, <s>svāhā</s>! O remover of all diseases, <s>svāhā</s>! O sustainer of the womb, <s>svāhā</s>! O remover of fear everywhere, <s>svāhā</s>! May there be well-being for me and all beings, <s>svāhā</s>! Oṃ bhuvaḥ <s>svāhā</s>! Well-being, <s>svāhā</s>! Peace, <s>svāhā</s>! Nourishment, <s>svāhā</s>! Strength-increasing, <s>svāhā</s>! Oṃ may she be victorious, O victorious one, O victorious lotus, O pure one, <s>svāhā</s>! O vast one, <s>svāhā</s>! O embodiment of all <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! Oṃ bhūri, O greatly peaceful one, <s>svāhā</s>! Oṃ bhuḥ bhūri bhūri, O vajra-endowed one, O one who fulfills the hearts of all <s>Tathāgatas</s>, O sustainer of life, O powerful one, O mighty one! Oṃ jayavijaye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ! Oṃ O jewel-bearer, O vajra-holder, hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ <s>svāhā</s>! Oṃ O jewel-vajra, O heart-vajra, O scatterer of <s>Māra's</s> armies, destroy, destroy all enemies, O vajra-womb, terrify, terrify all the abodes of <s>Māra</s>, hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ, gather, gather, <s>svāhā</s>! By the loving-kindness of the <s>Buddha</s>, empowered by the vajra chapter of all <s>Tathāgatas</s>, may all obstructions of <s>karma</s> be removed, <s>svāhā</s>!
